content: {"paper_id":"lab-8a85b44117f4","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"ensemble-clustering","exact_quote":"Ensemble clustering aggregates multiple weak clusterings to achieve a more accurate and robust consensus result.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文研究任务为集成聚类，融合多个弱聚类结果以获得更准确稳健的共识划分。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"Finally, the adversarial relationship between the similarity matrix and the dissimilarity matrix is utilized to construct a promoted CA matrix for ensemble clustering.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要提出构造/提升样本对共关联(CA)亲和矩阵，并利用相似度矩阵与不相似度矩阵关系，属于对样本间亲和结构的构建或修正。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"class-imbalance","reason_zh":"摘要提到簇质量与簇大小相关、小簇往往更准确，但未将类别/簇样本量不均衡作为研究设定或明确处理，证据不足以判定为类别不平衡学习。"}],"input_issues":[]}
